items.q: Synthetic related: a 29 year old woman has a carotid bruit and a string-of-beads carotid on imaging. The likely cause is

x.key: Carotid beads in a young woman are fibromuscular dysplasia, as in the renal artery.

others.A: Atheroma favours the carotid bulb in older patients.
others.C: Takayasu gives long smooth narrowings with systemic features.
others.D: A dissection gives a flap and sudden pain, not beads.

x.pearl: Beads in any medium artery of a young woman: fibromuscular dysplasia.
x.rev: Carotid string-of-beads in a young woman = fibromuscular dysplasia.

items.q: Synthetic related: Zika infection is confirmed at 18 weeks of gestation. The next step in fetal surveillance is

x.key: Serial head ultrasound watches for microcephaly after Zika in pregnancy.

others.A: Folic acid does not treat or monitor Zika.
others.C: Delivery at 18 weeks is not indicated without a fetal reason.
others.D: Steroids mature fetal lungs near term; they do not help here.

x.pearl: After Zika in pregnancy, watch the fetal head.
